name: gulf_to_iraq_blocked
input: Can I ship from Saudi Arabia to Iraq?
expected_output: No. Shipments from Gulf countries to Iraq are blocked, and Saudi Arabia is a Gulf country.

name: iraq_to_gulf_allowed
input: Can I ship from Iraq to Saudi Arabia?
expected_output: Yes. Shipping from Iraq to Saudi Arabia is allowed. Only shipments from Gulf countries to Iraq are blocked.

name: non_gulf_to_iraq_allowed
input: Can I ship from Jordan to Iraq?
expected_output: Yes. Shipping from Jordan to Iraq is allowed. Shipments from non-Gulf countries to Iraq are allowed.

name: signature_mandatory_egypt
input: Is a signature required when shipping to Egypt?
expected_output: Yes. A signature is mandatory for shipments to Egypt. It is selected automatically and the user cannot uncheck it. A $5.00 signature fee is added.

name: home_pickup_over_17kg
input: Can I use home pickup for an 18 kg package sent from Saudi Arabia?
expected_output: No. Home pickup is disabled for packages over 17 kg. The postal office is selected instead.

name: home_pickup_iraq_exception
input: Can I use home pickup for an 18 kg package sent from Iraq?
expected_output: Yes. Home pickup is available for senders in Iraq regardless of weight. The 17 kg limit does not apply to Iraq.

name: international_max_weight
input: What is the maximum weight for an International shipment?
expected_output: The maximum weight for an International shipment is 25 kg.

name: item_description_required
input: When is an item description required?
expected_output: An item description is required when the sender is in a non-Gulf country and the receiver is in a Gulf country. It must be at least 5 characters.

name: street_required_gulf
input: Is the street address required for a receiver in Saudi Arabia?
expected_output: Yes. The street address is required for receivers in Gulf countries, and Saudi Arabia is a Gulf country.

name: home_pickup_fee_jordan
input: How much is the home pickup fee for a sender in Jordan?
expected_output: The home pickup fee for a sender in Jordan is $12.00.

name: not_in_documentation
input: What are the customs duties for shipping to Egypt?
expected_output: The customs duties for shipping to Egypt are not specified in the documentation.

name: why_rule_exists
input: Why is shipping from Gulf countries to Iraq blocked?
expected_output: Shipments from Gulf countries to Iraq are blocked so that blocked shipping routes are enforced.

name: inconsistent_docs_shipment_type
input: What shipment type is a shipment from Egypt to Saudi Arabia?
expected_output: A shipment from Egypt to Saudi Arabia is International. Shipments from a non-Gulf country to a Gulf country are International.
